news.title: Mizzou innovation speeds up detection of deadly tick-borne disease
news.summary_en: Thanks to university researchers, Rocky Mountain spotted fever can now be detected in just 40 minutes, leading to earlier treatment.

news.title: From marathons to triathlons and beyond, Mizzou Tigers go the distance
news.summary_en: Mizzou faculty, staff and alumni are redefining what’s possible through perseverance and Tiger grit.
